section_summary.extract_value: This section presents regression analyses examining predictors of attitudes toward unconventional sex, analyzed separately by gender. For women, both regression steps were significant, with sexual orientation, BMI, body appreciation, and body image flexibility emerging as significant predictors. For men, only the second regression step was significant, with body appreciation and body image flexibility as the only significant predictors. The analyses suggest gender differences in the factors predicting attitudes toward unconventional sex.
